notes: I changed the model from predicting nothing to a cubic `y ≈ -3.9·x³` (the dominant behavior across E1 and E2, with the coefficient confirmed at large |x| from E1) plus a small Gaussian bump `+3.3·exp(-x²/2)` that captures the elevated values near x=0 seen in E2.
